### 📓 Docs Drift Check
This PR changes **1** package(s): `@objectstack/cli`, touching **16** documentable anchor(s).

**1** hand-written doc(s) NAME something this change touched and may need an implementation-accuracy re-verification:

- `content/docs/deployment/cli.mdx`  _(via os secret orphans (command, read off packages/cli/src/commands/secret/orphans.ts), os secret rewrap (command, read off packages/cli/src/commands/secret/rewrap.ts))_

⛔ **1** release-owned page(s) also name something this change touched. These are **read-only**:

- `content/docs/releases/v17/17-7.mdx`  _(via os secret orphans (command, read off packages/cli/src/commands/secret/orphans.ts), os secret rewrap (command, read off packages/cli/src/commands/secret/rewrap.ts))_

> `content/docs/releases/` is RELEASE-OWNED (AGENTS.md "Documentation Guardrails"): release
> notes are written centrally at release time, and a code PR that edits them is the exact PR
> that guardrail exists to stop. They are still audited — read-only. If one of them is actually
> wrong, **file an issue** or open a dedicated docs-only PR; do not edit it here.

<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- **1** anchor(s) matched too much of the corpus to be a work list: `os serve (command, 47 pages)`
- **2** name(s) were too generic to anchor anything (single lowercase words)
- the SDK route bridge reached **63** of **226** client-bound route-ledger rows — the other **163** have no registrar `path:` tail to select them, so pages documenting THEIR client methods cannot appear above, on this or any run. Of those **163**: **0** are remediable by widening that discovery convention (an in-repo file declares the path; the convention did not scan it); **59** are structural — on a ledger where NOT ONE row is declared in-repo, so no discovery change reaches them at any price; **104** are undecided (no in-repo declaration, on a ledger that has other in-repo registrars — absence and an unreadable spelling are not distinguishable here). The rows themselves: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --bridge-coverage`
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **35** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json fe97d85b060b8314880e8ee5f6f897ffbb300bcd` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

<details><summary>Which tree this was computed on</summary>

This run read `content/docs` from `4d47679c2433f7af12b32dd2cb12422a7b961071` — the merge of head `e82bb064300493750b2a3fdce690542839101a7f` into base `fe97d85b060b8314880e8ee5f6f897ffbb300bcd`, which is what `actions/checkout` gives a `pull_request` run. **Not** the PR head.

A worktree cut from an older `main` holds a different `content/docs`, so re-deriving there can legitimately return a different list — that is a **different tree, not a wrong row**. To answer on the same tree:

```sh
# while this PR is open — GitHub drops the merge commit once it closes
git fetch origin 4d47679c2433f7af12b32dd2cb12422a7b961071 && git checkout 4d47679c2433f7af12b32dd2cb12422a7b961071
# afterwards, rebuild it from the two parents, which stay fetchable
git fetch origin fe97d85b060b8314880e8ee5f6f897ffbb300bcd e82bb064300493750b2a3fdce690542839101a7f && git checkout -B drift-repro fe97d85b060b8314880e8ee5f6f897ffbb300bcd && git merge --no-ff e82bb064300493750b2a3fdce690542839101a7f

node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json fe97d85b060b8314880e8ee5f6f897ffbb300bcd
```

⚠️ That checkout carried **uncommitted changes**, so the commit above does not fully identify what was read.
</details>

> Advisory only, and a **precision-first** one (#9192): a page is listed because it names a
> symbol, wire route or SDK method this diff touched — not because it mentions a changed
> package. Each row says which anchor put it there, so a wrong row is reportable rather than
> merely annoying. To re-verify, run the `docs-accuracy-audit` workflow scoped to these files:
> `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs fe97d85b060b8314880e8ee5f6f897ffbb300bcd` → pass the list as
> `args.docs`, on the commit named under **Which tree this was computed on**.

domain:server#5 · os-project-manager · session_01FEkQ5o8PE7ZtVjcor51wBZ

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:一次性 CLI 密钥命令(`os secret rewrap`、`os secret orphans`、带设置服务的数据迁移)不再自建本地密钥提供方,而是用 `os serve` 同一个选择函数 `createHostCryptoProvider`:宿主配置里有插件声明 `crypto-provider` 就启动它并用它加解密;两个声明拒绝并点名两者;没有声明照旧用已存在的本地密钥。
- 为什么改:#30993 之后 `serve` 用插件注册的 KMS/Vault 提供方封存密钥,这些一次性命令仍用本地密钥,打不开 serve 封存的值;`rewrap` 甚至可能把行改封到本地密钥下(降级)。
- 风险与回滚:失败即关闭:声明的提供方启动失败、启动后没注册、或宿主配置/插件条目读不了,命令都拒绝、点名、不写任何行,⛔ 不回退本地密钥。新增一个读配置的步骤,配置坏了的项目上这些命令会从「照跑」变成「拒绝」。回滚即 revert。
- 先看:`packages/cli/src/utils/one-shot-settings.ts`(`oneShotCrypto` / `readDeclaredCryptoProvider`,拒绝分支);`packages/cli/src/commands/secret/rewrap.ts`(启动失败与 `confirm()` 的拒绝点);`packages/cli/src/commands/serve.ts` 抽出的 `cryptoProviderPlugins`。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/cli exec vitest run src/utils/one-shot-crypto-provider.test.ts src/commands/secret/rewrap.driver-contract.test.ts`,预期 `Tests 15 passed (15)`。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

席位意见:接受。三种情形与安全复核 6690506028 的「失败即关闭、不降级」一致;代价是配置读不了的项目上这几个命令会拒绝而不是照跑,这是有意的。开发者另报的 `os serve` 插件加载失败后继续启动的问题,席位已核对代码,另行保密处理,不在本 PR。

## 席位核对 — ACCEPT · `domain:server#5` · Head-sha `e82bb064300493750b2a3fdce690542839101a7f` · 2026-11-07T19:02Z

- **Shape:** 11 files, +800/−76, read from the diff (non-test: `one-shot-settings.ts` +183/−12, `rewrap.ts` +80/−24, `serve.ts` +25/−11, `data-migration-plugins.ts`, `orphans.ts`). `serve.ts` only extracts `cryptoProviderPlugins` from `refuseTwoCryptoProviderPlugins` (same reading, now shared). `oneShotCrypto` reads the host config's `plugins` (never `devPlugins`) by serve's own rules, refuses on an unreadable config or entry, refuses two declarers, and composes the declarer + `createHostCryptoProvider` + settings service; the declared path's local fallback is a refusal, and the declarer's `init()` failure is re-thrown naming it. `data-migration-plugins.ts`: the storage arm's optional settings no longer swallows a `HostCryptoProviderRefusal`.
- **Premise measured:** on main `one-shot-settings.ts` built `LocalCryptoProvider` for every one-shot run; `Blocked-by: #30948` closed.
- **Pins:** `one-shot-crypto-provider.test.ts` (one declarer boots and seals/opens; two refused naming both; boot failure / registers none / unreadable config or entry refused naming it), rewrap driver contract (refusal writes nothing, rows read back equal; ablated red under `env:OS_SECRET_KEY` and restored). Report 6711449188.
- **Gates:** head check-runs 35 `success`, 13 skipped, none red or pending. `check-expected-skips`: OK, all 13 in main's roster (exit 0). `check-governed-merges`: no governed path, 876 changed lines ≤ 3000. The dev's `dispatch-gates --commands`: 63 derived, 63 run, all exit 0. Mergeable state `clean`.
- **Accepted deviations:** thread-default effort (claim records it); lint run per touched file; refusal case ordered last in the driver contract because a failed `--json` boot keeps stdout reserved. New `--json` error string `crypto_provider_refused` on `os secret rewrap` is CLI output, not a ledger code or spec accept set: `Clause-②: no` holds.
- **Out of scope:** (1) serve's stack-plugin loop continues past a plugin that fails to load: verified by the seat at `serve.ts` (the `✗ Failed to load plugin` catch), routed confidentially, ⛔ not as a public issue. (2) An undeclared provider is not booted by a one-shot run; it cannot downgrade (the local key opens nothing it sealed; rewrap counts those `refused_unreadable` and writes nothing). (3) Installed plugins outside the declaration check stay on the card's last line, routed by triage. `Metadata-protocol: none`, `Skills-docs:` n/a. Changeset `@objectstack/cli` patch.
- **Landing:** ungoverned. `Fixes #31007`. Ready + auto-merge.
